data.title: Erasmus+ exchange: submit Learning Agreement
data.summary: The International Office of the University of Beispielstadt congratulates you on your Erasmus+ nomination for winter 2026/27 at the University of Musterholm. You must submit your signed Learning Agreement by 15 May 2026.
data.explanation: You have been nominated for an Erasmus+ exchange semester at the University of Musterholm. To move forward, upload your signed Learning Agreement in the Mobility-Online portal by 15 May 2026. Without it, the university cannot forward your application to the host university. If you have questions about the agreement, contact the International Office at the email address on the letter.
